messages.author: e466badf1c085931
messages.subject: annotating with gene.obj
parts:
Hi,
Can I annotate a list that was generated outside the methylKit environment using annotate.WithGenicParts? The list I have has the same columns as a methylDiff object,but when I try to use it with annotate.WithGenicParts, the error I get is 
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘annotate.WithGenicParts’ for signature ‘"list", "GRangesList"’
Thanks--Sumithra

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] annotating with gene.obj
parts:
if it is a GRanges object you can, it seems you are trying to annotate a GRangesList object. You need to convert it to a GRanges object or call  annotate.WithGenicParts() on each element of the GRangesList (which would be GRanges objects).

Best,
Altuna
